story.title: Stormfall and the Living Road
story.summary: A storm has damaged the woodland route. Recover practical supplies, clear two infestations, and brace the living root-channel before delivering your chosen allocation. Rill asks for field work.
story.danger: Two accepted encounters: 64 / 136 health and 9 / 11 damage, fixed for every weapon. Their 1.35-second tells and 2.3-second recovery leave room to Brace or retreat. Your free road home remains available.
story.completionText: The allocation is delivered and a separate brace carries the damaged connection. The old root organism remains alive. Rill recognizes your chosen practical approach; one Trailward binding is available at an outdoor home workbench.

steps.name: Read the camp load board
steps.text: Rill: The road and the watercourse share this load. Read what each needs before choosing a supply.
steps.completed: Read the camp load board recorded.

steps.name: Choose and prepare the supply
steps.text: Choose a physical preparation; the allocation is retained when you return.
steps.completed: Choose and prepare the supply recorded.

choices.name: Recover stormfall
choices.text: Recover already fallen timber and bind it for transport. The standing refuge stays intact. This pays 8 timber and 4 fibre; the binding needs two additional fibre from gathering or one patrol.
choices.completed: Stormfall allocation prepared. The standing refuge remains intact. Check the wetland watercourse.

choices.name: Prepare managed coppice
choices.text: Prepare a limited managed allocation with more binding fibre. This pays 4 timber and 8 fibre; the binding can be afforded from this allocation once the currency is claimed.
choices.completed: Managed allocation prepared. Its extra fibre is retained. Check the wetland watercourse.

steps.name: Check the wetland watercourse
steps.text: Read the watercourse before moving the load. The supply plan leaves this refuge and its drainage open.

steps.name: Clear the crossing infestation
steps.text: Disable the accepted Channel skitter through actual weapon impacts; the crossing itself stays supported and your exit stays free.

steps.name: Read the living root anchor
steps.text: The old organism carries part of the route. Read the damaged connection; cutting the living support away would transfer its load into the breach.
steps.completed: Read the living root anchor recorded.

steps.name: Clear the root-bank infestation
steps.text: Disable the accepted Root-bank brute in the open bank pocket, away from the passage walls.

steps.name: Fit the alternate route brace
steps.text: Fit the prepared alternate brace before releasing the damaged connection. The old organism stays alive; this records one local support repair.
steps.completed: Alternate brace fitted; the old root stays alive. Deliver your allocation at the return glade.

steps.name: Deliver the chosen allocation
steps.text: Deliver the retained practical allocation at the return glade. Return to Rill to explicitly claim the declared currency and materials.
steps.completed: Allocation delivered. Return to Rill for the declared payment; it remains unclaimed.

patrol.title: Living Road patrol
patrol.summary: After the first delivery is claimed, intentionally accept a new inspection circuit. Each accepted run owns new encounters and one payment; the living organism is never killed, reset or repaired again for payment.
patrol.danger: Two accepted encounters: 64 / 136 health and 9 / 11 damage, fixed for every weapon. Their 1.35-second tells and 2.3-second recovery leave room to Brace or retreat. Your free road home remains available.
patrol.completionText: The accepted inspection circuit is recorded and paid once. Your first support repair and allocation remain recognized.

steps.name: Inspect the wetland course
steps.text: Check that the wetland course remains open for this accepted patrol.

steps.name: Clear the patrol crossing pocket
steps.text: Clear this run’s actual crossing infestation; an old defeat cannot satisfy a new patrol.
steps.completed: Clear the patrol crossing pocket recorded.

steps.name: Inspect the supported root passage
steps.text: Inspect the existing alternate support. This is an inspection, not a repeated rescue or a new repair.
steps.completed: Inspect the supported root passage recorded.

steps.name: Clear the patrol bank pocket
steps.text: Clear this run’s actual bank infestation; the living root anchor is not a foe.
steps.completed: Clear the patrol bank pocket recorded.

steps.name: Record the return glade
steps.text: Record the end of this patrol and return to Rill for its explicitly declared payment.
